The fix and the management controls are in. Please **reload http://maker:4001**.

**First, the "All" fix — please re-check the thing you flagged:**
Click a topic button, type something in the search box, then click **All**. Confirm it now clears the search *and* shows every link again.

**Next — editing a link (please try):**
Each link now has an **Edit** button on its right. Click **Edit** on any link. I set it up so the link turns into editable fields **right there in place** (address, title, topic), with **Save changes** and **Cancel**. Change its topic to something new and click **Save changes** — confirm the link moves under the new topic and the topic buttons update.

*Assumption to check:* I chose to let you edit **in place within the list** rather than opening a separate popup form. Please tell me if editing right where the link sits feels right, or if you'd expect a separate window.

**Then — deleting a link (please try):**
Click **Delete** on a link. I set it up so that instead of removing it instantly, it **asks you to confirm** first with a red **Delete** / **Keep** choice. Click **Delete** to confirm it's gone; try another and click **Keep** to back out.

*Assumption to check:* I added that confirm step on purpose so a link can't vanish by accident — does that safety step match what you'd want, or would you rather it just delete immediately?

Tell me how each of the three behaves, and whether the in-place editing and the delete confirmation match your instinct.
